title: Sistem Pengurusan Program
summary: Programme and participant management: every programme gets a QR code, people register themselves with their IC number, and organisers get lists, Excel exports and reports.
body:
Programme and participant management, with a QR code at every event so people register themselves.

Each programme gets its own QR code. Participants scan it, enter their IC number, and either confirm the details the system already holds or fill in the form once. Organisers see who joined what, move lists in and out of Excel, and report by state, region and year. It is a Laravel application with a Blade, Tailwind CSS and Flowbite interface.

I have maintained it since January 2024, with fixes still going in at the end of 2025.

highlights.title: A QR code per programme
highlights.text: Creating a programme generates a QR code for its registration form. The link carries an encrypted programme ID, so form addresses cannot be guessed or stepped through.

highlights.title: Register once, join many
highlights.text: A participant is identified by their IC number. Returning participants confirm the details already on file instead of typing them again, each programme keeps its own participation record, and registering twice for the same programme is refused.

highlights.title: IC numbers checked at the door
highlights.text: A number must be 12 digits with a valid state code before anything is saved.

highlights.title: Excel in and out
highlights.text: Programmes and participant lists import from Excel, a thousand rows at a time for the bulk import, and export per programme, by division or by year.

highlights.title: Reports by state, region and year
highlights.text: Programmes and participants are grouped by state and by region and filtered by year, with a printable report.

highlights.title: Accountable by default
highlights.text: Three roles (super admin, admin and viewer). Logins are logged, every programme change is recorded with who made it, and accounts created with a system password must change it first.
